message:
olivia: FYI partner (SI: BrightWave) just flagged missing sku_tag in ~0.4% of hourly usage batches this morning. billing credits not showing up in their portal :thinking_face:
raj: can you paste an example payload? is it empty string or missing field?
olivia: missing field entirely, here's a sanitized sample we got from them:
```
{
  "partner_id": "brightwave-001",
  "timestamp": "2026-03-22T08:12:00Z",
  "usage": [
    { "meter_id": "gen-text", "units": 120 },
    { "meter_id": "embed-v1", "units": 40 }
  ]
}
```
kevin: ugh — our ingest assumes sku_tag present to map to marketplace plan. fallback currently maps to default_free_sku which yields 0 credits. that explains it.
kevin: quick question — are these partners sending newer schema? did they upgrade their agent recently?
olivia: they updated their aggregator yesterday but said only minor stability fixes. they pushed without schema bump so it slipped by QA.
anna: this will impact revenue recognition for those accounts if not fixed + backfilled. can we do a short-term crediting rule until we fix mapping?
raj: propose 2-step: 1) ingest change to treat missing sku_tag as "partner_meter_id+meter_id" composite key for mapping, 2) run backfill job for last 72 hours for brightwave-001.
kevin: agree. implementation notes: add a validation hook in the marketplace-ingest lambda that emits metric:missing_sku_tag and sets "sku_hint" = partner_id + ":" + meter_id. then existing mapper will try sku_hint before falling back to default_free_sku.
kevin: SQL for backfill (draft):
```
UPDATE usage_ledger u
SET sku_assigned = m.sku
FROM (
  SELECT u.id, coalesce(m.sku, lookup.default_sku) AS sku
  FROM raw_usage u
  LEFT JOIN sku_mapping m ON m.partner_key = u.partner_id || ':' || u.meter_id
  LEFT JOIN default_lookup lookup ON lookup.partner_id = u.partner_id
  WHERE u.partner_id = 'brightwave-001' AND u.event_ts >= now() - interval '72 hours'
) m
WHERE u.id = m.id;
```
marketplace-bot: [ALERT] webhook-retry failure for brightwave-001 at 2026-03-22T08:15:12Z (status 502)
olivia: marketplace-bot pinged me earlier. they had intermittent 502s while switching their aggregator. might be correlated.
anna: action items: @kevin implement ingest fallback + metric (P0, 4h), @raj run backfill job + sanity checks (P0, 6h), @olivia coordinate partner comms and confirm schema plan (P1, EOD).
raj: I'll queue backfill now against staging and attach run logs here. doing a dry-run first.
kevin: starting on lambda change now. will add unit test for new sku_hint order and a prometheus counter for missing_sku_tag.
olivia: for partner message: propose we tell them: "we observed missing sku tags in some batches during your recent agent update; we've implemented a temporary mapping and will backfill credits for the last 72 hours; please pin the agent version or add schema version header to future pushes." thoughts?
anna: language looks good. add timeline and the fact we will reconcile charges in next billing cycle.
olivia: noted. I'll send a short note and include the backfill run id once raj posts it.
raj: dry-run complete in staging, 28 events would have been remapped. running prod backfill now (job id bkf-20260322-01). ETA ~12m.
marketplace-bot: [JOB] bkf-20260322-01 started by raj at 2026-03-22T08:29:10Z
kevin: code change pushed to feature branch, opened PR #4523. adding reviewers @anna and @olivia.
olivia: thanks. after backfill finishes let's validate 3 sample customer accounts in the marketplace portal before emailing partners.
raj: backfill finished, 312 rows updated, checksum diff matches dry-run. attaching quick diff: +312 sku assignments, +$482.76 credited to customer ledgers.
olivia: perfect. I'll draft partner email and include remediation steps and ask them to add schema header next release.
anna: nice work team. please add a short postmortem note in this thread later summarizing root cause and next steps to prevent recurrence. :white_check_mark:
kevin: retrospective notes I'll add to PR and link here. will also create a guard in e2e CI that fails if agent changes payload shape without schema version bump.
olivia: closing loop: partner confirmed receipt and thanked us. marking this thread resolved. :tada:
